metaTitle: Custom Full Color Hand Sanitizer | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom full color hand sanitizer for your brand. Perfect for events, offices, and giveaways. Bulk pricing available.
introHtml: Full color decoration on hand sanitizer bottles lets you reproduce logos, photos, or complex artwork with vibrant detail. Unlike single-color imprints, full color sleeves or wraps give you unlimited design possibilities, making your sanitizer stand out at trade shows, employee wellness kits, or client appreciation packages. Options like the 1 oz Gel Sanitizer in a trapezoid bottle with a full color sleeve combine practicality with eye-catching branding that reinforces your message every time someone reaches for it.
heroAltText: Custom full color hand sanitizer bottles with vibrant printed sleeves featuring company logos and artwork
